cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a starship data archive — kneeling on the ground; a small far-future planetarium rehearsal room on an orbital habitat — off duty she tries an event-host costume while turning a little eclipse disc in front of a lamp; an art or pottery studio of easels — holds her keepsake at chest height; a modern miniature-terrarium stall beneath a skylight — she places a tiny pale porous stone among damp moss inside a glass globe and tilts the globe to watch a faint veil of condensation clear; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — holds a masquerade mask on a stick up to her eyes; her living room with a deep sofa — plays an acoustic guitar; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — standing; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — holds a few lit incense sticks in both hands before her; a desert oasis at golden hour — kneeling on the ground; her crew cabin aboard a starship — places a stone on a go board with black and white stones on the table; a neon-lit game arcade — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a themed costume event venue with props and a photo wall — standing; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — seated sideways on a stool or bench
